parsed.note_claim: Numerous fact checks debunked the claims that USAID gave Chelsea Clinton millions of dollars.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The claim that USAID provided the $84 million in funding is also incorrect. Snopes reported, citing USAspending.gov, that the Clinton Foundation did not receive any money from the USAID from the 2008 fiscal year to now.
parsed.reason: The Newsweek fact check directly debunks the post's claim that USAID gave Chelsea Clinton millions, confirming USAID did not provide the funding and Chelsea Clinton received no compensation from the foundation.
